opportunities.name: Trip.com attraction ticket search by city, keyword, and sort
opportunities.description: Search Trip.com's Attractions & Tickets for a chosen city and optional keyword, sort results (e.g. Top Rated or Lowest Price), and open a chosen attraction.
steps: Click 'Attractions & Tickets' in the Trip.com navigation
Click the 'City or Region' textbox and type the city name
Pick the matching city suggestion from the dropdown
Optionally type a keyword (e.g. 'amusement park') into the Keywords field
Click the search icon or 'Search'
Choose a sort option such as 'Top Rated' or 'Lowest Price'
Click the desired attraction in the results list
Open the attraction's detail view ('Nearby' or the info icon) if needed

instances.values: city=Hong Kong; keyword='Park'; sort=Top Rated; attraction=Shanghai Wild Animal Park (then 'Nearby')
city=Seoul, South Korea; keyword='amusement park'; sort=Lowest Price; attraction=Cerdon caves - Prehistoric Amusement Park (then info icon)

opportunities.name: KOA campground search and stay booking by location
opportunities.description: Find KOA campgrounds for a location (optionally filtered, e.g. RV sites), and for a booking, renew or sign in to the KOA Rewards account, pick a campground, set check-in and check-out dates, and run the search.
steps: Optionally click 'Filters' and tick a filter such as 'RV Site'
Click the 'WHERE DO YOU WANT TO GO?' textbox and type the location
Click 'FIND A KOA'
For a booking: open the Rewards program page and choose 'Purchase or renew' and 'Renew - An existing account'
Type the location, enter the KOA Rewards number and postal code, and click 'Continue'
Select the campground from the results list
Set the 'CHECK IN' date and click through the calendar with 'Next' as needed
Set the 'CHECK OUT' date and click 'FIND A KOA'

instances.values: filter=RV Site; location=California; then FIND A KOA (search only)
renewal account=KOA Rewards number 1000000001; postal code=10023; location=Lansing; campground=Holly KOA (Holly, MI); check-in=7th; check-out=12th; then FIND A KOA

opportunities.name: Qatar Airways baggage allowance lookup by route and cabin class
opportunities.description: On Qatar Airways' travel-requirements/baggage page, enter a departure and return airport, choose a cabin class, and open the baggage allowance view for that route.
steps: Click 'Travel requirements' (or 'Experience' if already on the page)
Type the departure city in the 'Enter your Depart place' box and pick the airport suggestion
Type the return city in the 'Enter your return place' box and pick the airport suggestion
Click 'Check requirements'
Click 'Experience', then 'Baggage allowance'
Click the cabin class link (e.g. 'Economy Class' or 'Business Class')

instances.values: depart=Tokyo Haneda (HND); return=Guangzhou Baiyun (CAN); cabin=Economy Class
cabin=Business Class; route not re-entered in this occurrence (likely carried over from the session)
